checkpoints.description: [1/2] Scaffold a React surface with token theme, inventory proof and UI contract

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for a test project to exercise AIKit's UI changes.
impact_assessment.benefits: A runnable React+Vite surface with a committed bounded UI contract and mechanical proofs.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new .aikit/ui.json surface app; dependency: react, react-dom, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react; concurrency: none; state: .aikit/ui.json committed as baseline
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep edits inside src/**, prove with npm run build, npm test and npm run ui:snapshot, then run aikit check.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Phase 4 gates pass (test, build, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); checklists: passed
[1/2] Polish the surface visuals while preserving every inventory entry

impact_assessment.why: Exercise a real bounded UI change under the committed contract.
impact_assessment.benefits: A more polished, responsive surface and evidence the UI guard catches scope, snapshot and style drift.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: surface app stays src/**; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: .aikit/ui_task.json records the baseline
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep data-ui and data-panel sets unchanged, use theme tokens only, then run npm test, npm run build and aikit ui verify.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Visual polish applied in src/App.jsx, src/styles.css and src/theme.css; ui verify passed with 0 strikes; awaiting human review
Human review declined; the UI task stays open and src/ changes stay uncommitted until a human reviews the running UI
Task 'ui-sandbox-polish' abandoned: UI polish aborted after human review was declined; diff archived to temp, publishing the committed baseline
[1/2] Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs install, tests, build and the UI inventory

impact_assessment.why: The published repository should prove itself on every push.
impact_assessment.benefits: Remote regression shield and a visible delivery baseline for the sandbox.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no UI contract change; dependency: actions/checkout and actions/setup-node only; concurrency: independent CI job; state: new .github/workflows/ci.yml
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin node 20, use npm ci, update the README tree in the same commit, then run aikit check --strict before committing.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] CI workflow added and README updated; Phase 4 gates pass; checklists: passed
[1/1] Document the account-level GitHub Actions startup failure

impact_assessment.why: The Verify workflow fails in 0s with no jobs, matching AIKit ADR-042.
impact_assessment.benefits: The repository states the blocker and keeps the local gate authoritative.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: decisions.md only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: ADR-002 appended
impact_assessment.mitigation: Record the evidence and run aikit check --strict before committing.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] ADR-002 records the startup failure and ADR-001 text is repaired; checklists: passed
